mapper.select: SELECT d.document_id AS documentId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, d.detail_title AS detailTitle, d.sections_json AS sectionsJson, d.raw_json AS rawJson FROM law_api_document_details d JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = d.document_id WHERE d.document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_api_document_details ( document_id, detail_title, meta_json, sections_json, raw_json, content_hash, sync_status, last_error_message, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{detail.documentId}, #{detail.detailTitle}, #{detail.metaJson}, #{detail.sectionsJson}, #{detail.rawJson}, #{detail.contentHash}, 'SYNCED', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE detail_title = VALUES(detail_title), meta_json = VALUES(meta_json), sections_json = VALUES(sections_json), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), sync_status = 'SYNCED', last_error_message = NULL, fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
